detail.title: 瓷砖铺设装置
detail.abstract: The utility model discloses a ceramic tile laying device, it belongs to the building decoration field. It mainly includes the ceramic tile support frame, and the front of ceramic tile support frame is equipped with the peaceful put one's child in a boarding nursery pole of vacuum chuck, and the back of ceramic tile support frame is equipped with the vacuum pump and strikes hammer, vacuum chuck and vacuum pump connection, ceramic tile support frame bottom is equipped with the transversal joint sighting rod, be equipped with buffer spring between vacuum chuck and the ceramic tile support frame. The utility model discloses a polylith ceramic tile is laid simultaneously, subsides the tamp simultaneously, and the ceramic tile surfacing laid, even, the no hollowing in gap. The utility model discloses laying of mainly used floor tile and wall tile.
